## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive (narrow/weak). VXX (1W: +2.55% | 1M: -7.10%) RECOVERY (short-term uptick ↑, month ↓) and SPY (1W: -1.15% | 1M: -1.06%) BELOW TREND with SPY/TLT neutral confirm mixed stance, while HYG/LQD shows credit stress rising (HYG (1W: -0.77% | 1M: -0.73%) BELOW TREND; LQD (1W: -1.12% | 1M: -1.28%) BELOW TREND).

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Credit stress rising: HYG/LQD ↑ (HYG (1W: -0.77% | 1M: -0.73%) BELOW TREND; LQD (1W: -1.12% | 1M: -1.28%) BELOW TREND). Fear mixed: VXX (1W: +2.55% | 1M: -7.10%) RECOVERY shows a short-term pick-up in volatility despite month decline.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral: Dollar flat (Dollar Strength 1W: 0.00% | 1M: -0.14% → flat) and yield-curve essentially unchanged (Yield Curve 1W: 0.00% | 1M: -0.58% → flat), with duration preference steady (Duration Preference 1W: 0.00% | 1M: +0.80% → flat).

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +0.80% | 1M: +6.73%) ABOVE TREND; Tech mixed: XLK (1W: +0.91% | 1M: -0.63%) RECOVERY while the rest of sectors are weak (sector breadth 1/11).

5. US vs Global?  
US equities soft: SPY (1W: -1.15% | 1M: -1.06%) BELOW TREND, while EM showing relative strength: EEM (1W: +0.55% | 1M: +2.08%) ABOVE TREND; China lagging: FXI (1W: -2.41% | 1M: -2.10%) BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculation mixed and corrective: IBIT (1W: -5.57% | 1M: +21.96%) CORRECTION and ARKK (1W: -4.09% | 1M: +2.72%) CORRECTION, while small-cap IWM (1W: -2.13% | 1M: -4.57%) BELOW TREND shows risk-off at the margin.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Commodities led by oil: USO (1W: +9.02% | 1M: +21.68%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +9.79% | 1M: +21.00%) ABOVE TREND, while industrial metals CPER (1W: -1.83% | 1M: -2.10%) BELOW TREND.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy strength intact: XLE (1W: +0.80% | 1M: +6.73%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +9.79% | 1M: +21.00%) ABOVE TREND, but natural gas UNG (1W: -3.05% | 1M: -0.29%) BELOW TREND is weak.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
Confirmed: Energy leadership (XLE and oil ETFs both ABOVE TREND). Major divergence across core risk assets: SPY (1W: -1.15% | 1M: -1.06%) BELOW TREND vs XLK (1W: +0.91% | 1M: -0.63%) RECOVERY and TLT (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -1.13%) BELOW TREND — suppresses strong directional bets.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor energy and oil exposure (XLE (1W: +0.80% | 1M: +6.73%) ABOVE TREND; BNO (1W: +9.79% | 1M: +21.00%) ABOVE TREND) and selective EM (EEM (1W: +0.55% | 1M: +2.08%) ABOVE TREND), reduce exposure to broad US beta and small caps (SPY (1W: -1.15% | 1M: -1.06%) BELOW TREND; IWM (1W: -2.13% | 1M: -4.57%) BELOW TREND) and monitor credit via HYG/LQD.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: Energy — XLE (1W: +0.80% | 1M: +6.73%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +9.79% | 1M: +21.00%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Biotech/Health and Industrials — XBI (1W: -4.98% | 1M: -2.00%) BELOW TREND, XLI (1W: -1.25% | 1M: -7.27%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: Oil — USO (1W: +9.02% | 1M: +21.68%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +9.79% | 1M: +21.00%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Copper and NatGas — CPER (1W: -1.83% | 1M: -2.10%) BELOW TREND, UNG (1W: -3.05% | 1M: -0.29%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?  
VIX/VXX complacency area near VIX ~18 (VIX 1W: +0.00% | 1M: -6.64% → flat); HYG/LQD around 0.75 (HYG_LQD Level: 0.7535, credit stress rising) as a credit-health pivot; Tech vs Financials ratio level ~3.28 (Tech/Fin 1W: +0.00% | 1M: +0.34% → flat) as a style watch.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive, signaling narrow market participation. Energy showing relative strength — XLE (1W: +0.80% | 1M: +6.73%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +9.79% | 1M: +21.00%) ABOVE TREND; key risk is the major divergence between headline equity weakness (SPY (1W: -1.15% | 1M: -1.06%) BELOW TREND) and mixed tech/credit signals (XLK (1W: +0.91% | 1M: -0.63%) RECOVERY; HYG/LQD showing credit stress ↑).
